references.text: The same principle that a man's silence confirms a woman's vow, as established earlier in the chapter
Parallel text about the husband's right to approve or annul his wife's vows by remaining silent or speaking
Summary of the principle that silence from the husband confirms all vows and binding obligations
The preacher warns about the importance of keeping vows to God, related to the seriousness of making an oath
The requirement in the Mosaic Law to keep what one has promised with one's mouth, which supports the principle of binding vows
